# GIN transparent recovery step 1: results (generated by scripts/ts1/{rows,summarize,lat_summary,psn_check}.py from the raw per-trial files)

The per-trial directories (runs/, confirm/, lat/, ...) are stored here as `<dir>.tar.xz`; extract them to re-run the scripts.

Builds: runs/ cells except f1g0_b, lat/, lat_attr/, f1g0_before_opmu_fix/: libnccl 203e364e (step-1 build before the opMu fix); runs/f1g0_b_*, confirm/, confirm_lat/: libnccl 59c283ff (final). Driver gin_ts1 0a686a08 in all; gpudb baseline base/: libnccl 1ed8e0a1 + driver 14463ed0.
